methodology: Production build verified against served artifact SHA256 hashes, sequential Lighthouse navigations, default Lighthouse simulated throttling, fresh browser storage per measured run. No audit-level request blocking or network overrides; the application MSW and Socket.IO simulation runs unchanged. Preflight rejects the development server and verifies API data, visible page and Socket.IO connection. Every run is retained; median does not discard any run.

gate.scope: Performance only; other Lighthouse categories are reported separately.
